### Annual Report 2025

B. Braun continued its long-term growth path in fiscal year 2025. Group sales increase by 5.1
percent at constant currencies to € 9.4 billion.

][159]
[
[nurse talking with patient at the bedsite]

### More time for patient care.

Global staff shortages make health care professionals the most valuable resource in hospitals. Their
most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

][160]
[
[A healthcare professional is shown standing proudly with a sustainable-produced medical container.]

### New standards in sterile processing and operating room supply

A reliable and efficient supply of the OR is essential for creating daily and long-term success in
hospital processes. Digitally enhanced solutions to achieve clinical excellence.

][161]
[
[A medical laboratory employee is pouring liquid for a quality check.]

### Sustainability from the depths

With the expansion of its disinfectant production facility in Sempach, Switzerland, B. Braun is now
seizing the opportunity to set new standards in energy management.

][162]
[
[Digital microscope for neurosurgery named Aesculap Aeos® in front of a white background]

### A precise view of the future: New digital microscope technology for neurosurgery

New technology allows high-resolution views into the human body, making it a prerequisite for more
precise surgery.

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

* Business Solutions
  Business Solutions
  
  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to
  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.
  
  [ Explore ][51]
  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention

# ABOUT US

### Ananta International Limited (AIL) was set up in 2015 as a business advisory, project
### integration and consultancy services company to participate in the burgeoning IT,
### infrastructure, industrial and education markets in fast growh countries. The company draws its
### strength from the extensive  experience of its founders in project sales and execution; in
### managing engineering companies in the manufacturing and services sector; and in running
### educational institutions in Dubai and India.



### We have recently added marketing, sales and distribution of Covid-19 testing kits to our
### portfolio. 



### Our business model is based on pooling the strengths and capabilities of UK, EU and Indian
### companies / institutions into project specific partnerships / consortiums to create competitive
### business propositions and eventually win identified projects. Once projects are won we are
### usually retained by the consortium as the project coordinator to facilitate the process of 
### delivery as contracted.  We operate within the legal framework of the territories involved and
### are compliant with professional standards.



### Animesh Basu

### Director - Business Advisory Services

Animesh has 35 years international experience in project sales, acquisition and delivery. He has
founded and managed three technology start-ups  and was the CEO of Artevea Digital Limited, a
Cambridge UK based global supplier of digital radio communications equipment. He has worked in
India  (18 years) which included a 5 year stint with the Foreign Office as Senior Trade Adviser in
the UKTI export promotion service, Russia (5 years) and the UAE(10 years). Animesh is also a
director  of Artevea Digital India Limited, an established player in turnkey telecommunications
projects and services based in Noida, UP, India. He has a Bachelors degree in Engineering from IIT
Kanpur and an MBA from Strathclyde University Business School.

### We have special skills and a strong knowledge base which we apply in the education sector.
### Educational institutions in emerging markets have to reorient their curricula to meet new
### demands for skills in the job market. The UK has a strong tradition in developing world class
### vocational courses and training programmes. AIL is positioned to fill this demand gap through
### working with UK institutions to develop courses and training programmes and implement them in
### identified educational institutions in the target markets through a technical collaboration /
### partnership with commercial benefits to all the consortium partners.



### Our revenue is based on success and actual milestones achieved for our professional services. We
### work only on concrete and realistic projects that have been properly validated through our local
### ground work. For this we use our own local offices and a network of long standing and reliable
### partners. In the validation process we duly gauge the technical and financial feasibility before
### commencing the partnership and integration work. Our consultants will carefully assess the
### wining chances giving due weightage to competition and analysing the unique elements that we
### must bring to the table to get the key strategic advantage. This includes the political factors
### that influence the award of contracts.

### Tapti Basu

### Director - Publishing and Education services

Tapti has 30 years experience as an academic, author and administrator. She has done tenure as
Vice-President Academic of ECMIT, Dubai and the Vice-Chancellor of Indus International University,
Una, Himachal Pradesh, India. She has authored two books and is currently working on her third book.
She has held the position of the Resident Editor of Asian Age newspaper. Besides her extensive
experience in administration and management, Tapti brings her deep understanding of Asia and Middle
East markets and strategic vision to the business. Her academic background and contact base is an
asset for the educational projects sector. Tapti has a PhD from the University of Calcutta.

# ABOUT US

### Ananta International Limited (AIL) was set up in 2015 as a business advisory, project
### integration and consultancy services company to participate in the burgeoning IT,
### infrastructure, industrial and education markets in fast growh countries. The company draws its
### strength from the extensive  experience of its founders in project sales and execution; in
### managing engineering companies in the manufacturing and services sector; and in running
### educational institutions in Dubai and India.



### We have recently added marketing, sales and distribution of Covid-19 testing kits to our
### portfolio. 



### Our business model is based on pooling the strengths and capabilities of UK, EU and Indian
### companies / institutions into project specific partnerships / consortiums to create competitive
### business propositions and eventually win identified projects. Once projects are won we are
### usually retained by the consortium as the project coordinator to facilitate the process of 
### delivery as contracted.  We operate within the legal framework of the territories involved and
### are compliant with professional standards.



### Animesh Basu

### Director - Business Advisory Services

Animesh has 35 years international experience in project sales, acquisition and delivery. He has
founded and managed three technology start-ups  and was the CEO of Artevea Digital Limited, a
Cambridge UK based global supplier of digital radio communications equipment. He has worked in
India  (18 years) which included a 5 year stint with the Foreign Office as Senior Trade Adviser in
the UKTI export promotion service, Russia (5 years) and the UAE(10 years). Animesh is also a
director  of Artevea Digital India Limited, an established player in turnkey telecommunications
projects and services based in Noida, UP, India. He has a Bachelors degree in Engineering from IIT
Kanpur and an MBA from Strathclyde University Business School.

### We have special skills and a strong knowledge base which we apply in the education sector.
### Educational institutions in emerging markets have to reorient their curricula to meet new
### demands for skills in the job market. The UK has a strong tradition in developing world class
### vocational courses and training programmes. AIL is positioned to fill this demand gap through
### working with UK institutions to develop courses and training programmes and implement them in
### identified educational institutions in the target markets through a technical collaboration /
### partnership with commercial benefits to all the consortium partners.



### Our revenue is based on success and actual milestones achieved for our professional services. We
### work only on concrete and realistic projects that have been properly validated through our local
### ground work. For this we use our own local offices and a network of long standing and reliable
### partners. In the validation process we duly gauge the technical and financial feasibility before
### commencing the partnership and integration work. Our consultants will carefully assess the
### wining chances giving due weightage to competition and analysing the unique elements that we
### must bring to the table to get the key strategic advantage. This includes the political factors
### that influence the award of contracts.

### Tapti Basu

### Director - Publishing and Education services

Tapti has 30 years experience as an academic, author and administrator. She has done tenure as
Vice-President Academic of ECMIT, Dubai and the Vice-Chancellor of Indus International University,
Una, Himachal Pradesh, India. She has authored two books and is currently working on her third book.
She has held the position of the Resident Editor of Asian Age newspaper. Besides her extensive
experience in administration and management, Tapti brings her deep understanding of Asia and Middle
East markets and strategic vision to the business. Her academic background and contact base is an
asset for the educational projects sector. Tapti has a PhD from the University of Calcutta.

Our manufacturing facilities in Greater Noida offer top-notch facilities that research, manufacture,
assemble, package, and sterilise both components and completed goods that are shipped throughout the
world. They contain 4 cutting-edge Class 10,000 clean rooms.

With over 30 years’ experience and expertise in the field of Plastics Parts Manufacturing, BL sets
the worldwide industry standard for product quality and reliability. A commitment to customer
relations and our teams’ strong R&D background, have given rise to a unique ability to customize

LOTS Wholesale Solutions, a leading business-to-business wholesaler in India is focused on providing
a one-stop-shop solution for its valued customers. LOTS has been serving its registered members
including Retailers HoReCa (Hotels, Restaurants, caterings) and service providers in Delhi NCR.
